term_implications: If approved for API or Virtual Data Enclave access, your institution may need to sign the Restricted Data Use Agreement (RDUA) via ICPSR/SOMAR.
The RDUA can require a PhD-holding lead investigator and faculty-level appointment, stricter than DSA Article 40(12).
Secure environments typically prevent downloading data; analysis happens in a monitored cleanroom.
Statistical outputs may require ICPSR disclosure review before sharing outside the project.
Annual reporting to ICPSR (IRB approvals, publications, staff changes) may be required for RDUA access.
Broad indemnity obligations may apply to your institution under the RDUA.
